designationHistory.indexText: Occoquan Bay National Wildlife Refuge was established in June 1998 to provide habitat for migratory birds and endangered species.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Occoquan Bay National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

review.note: Conflict: FWS page says June 1998; the CCP gives July 15, 1994, under the FY1995 Military Construction Appropriations Act. The Army facility closed Sept. 1994 and the land moved to FWS later. Earlier Marumsco NWR (1973) was merged in. Needs the transfer/establishment order.
